description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectActivityAPI class within the OrangeHRM's Time API module. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing project activities, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project activity records. It uses various traits and dependencies for handling business logic, validation, and data access related to project activities in the HR management system.

classes.name: ProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing project activities within the OrangeHRM system, providing endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project activity records associated with specific projects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list project activities for a specific project, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project activity under a specified project.

methods.name: setParamsToProjectActivity
methods.description: Maps request parameters to a ProjectActivity entity instance for creation or update.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing project activities, including filtering and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getProjectIdParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the projectId URL parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more project activities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, including projectId and activity IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific project activity by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single project activity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project activity based on provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a project activity, including uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper function to generate validation rules for the request body, especially for the 'name' and project association.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Builds and returns an option object for ensuring 'name' is unique within the project context, ignoring the current entity during updates.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts project ID and activity ID from URL parameters for internal use.
